g.text: A PDF view's modes (ADR-0045): the Document layout, the Slides layout, and Presenting
a PDF view is mounted (vinary.ui.views/pdf-view → renderer.pdf controller)
a click advances · idle pointer hides
continuous pages · zoom and Fit apply
one slide per screen · 16 px margin
the current one, or a page
the same key · a slide step
focus the address bar or sidebar
Escape unwinds one step at a time
overview → typed number → blanking → the show.
Ending a show leaves only a fullscreen
unmount — a tab switch, navigation, Reflow
Fill: where the state is held · Arrow: what triggers it
fill: the PDF engine (renderer.pdf :layout, the slide shown) · arrow: the view itself — mount, unmount, the layout a show returns to
arrow: a key only (the :slides keymap layer, Escape)
arrow: a command — keys, menus, toolbar, slide bar, context menu or palette
arrow (dashed): the window — main reports vv:fullscreen-changed
